_doc: The trench budget's measures (2026-10-22): the deep sea floor against Earth's (SRTM15+ at 15', tools/review/earth-deep-floor.py; ledger HYP-050, HYP-051) and the losses at subduction zones against Stern & Scholl 2010 Table 1. Pass it with --registry tools/review/pool/measures_trench.json (or DEEPTIME_POOL_MEASURES) and --measures v1census,trench. Definitions in measure_trench.py. The deep6 target is Earth's 0.0073 (15') to 0.0095 (Harris et al. 2014, SRTM30_PLUS) with room for the L1 grid's 44 km cells and the plate model's 71 km trench rows (game-choice: tolerance, agent 2026-10-22); deepest spans Earth's 9,242 m at 15' and Challenger Deep's 10,920 m.
